columns.order: result schema ordinal; stable ordinal IDs; duplicate names permitted
columns.truncation: none; out-of-bounds inputs return table fallback

canonical.schema: ordered column array with name, optional explicit semantic type and rows as equal-length arrays
canonical.type_resolution: Explicit valid semantic type wins; otherwise identifier if ASCII lowercase column name is id, uuid or ends _id and all nonmissing values are strings or safe integers; temporal if all nonmissing values are valid ISO date-only or RFC3339 timestamp strings with explicit offset; quantitative if all nonmissing values are finite numbers excluding boolean; nominal otherwise including all missing. Explicit incompatible types reject input.
canonical.missing: null, NaN, infinity, empty string; whitespace-only strings are valid; nested values rejected; missing cells represented by true in per-cell mask outside model inputs
canonical.numeric: IEEE binary64, safe integer range, normalize negative zero; temporal values UTC seconds; typed equality; no coercion of numeric strings
canonical.statistics: N total rows, M total columns, n nonmissing observations in column, K typed distinct nonmissing values; numeric-only statistics apply to quantitative columns; temporal steps only temporal; population moments; exact median and type-7 quantile (linear interpolation at (n-1)p); fewer than two adjacent pairs for temporal step CV => 0; no pairs => 0; constant variance => 0 for standardized moments Entropy uses natural logarithms. j is zero-based ordinal; mu and sigma are population mean and standard deviation. Adjacent nonmissing pairs are formed after filtering missing observations, preserving original order. All-empty columns nominal unless explicit type.
canonical.float: binary64 intermediates; finite result clipped to declared range then float32 round-to-nearest-even; nonfinite defaults; parity atol=1e-6 rtol=1e-6
canonical.lexer: ASCII case-insensitive unquoted keyword tokens; whitespace and comments excluded; single-quoted strings and quoted identifiers are opaque single tokens, escaped doubled delimiters honored; support SQL line and block comments, brackets, backticks and double quotes; punctuation and operators separate tokens; lexical only, not execution or full AST; malformed/unclosed quote or comment rejects inference Outer SELECT is first SELECT at minimum parenthesis depth after any CTE bodies; projection ends at FROM or set operator at same depth; split expressions only at commas of same depth. Clause ends at next clause keyword (HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT, OFFSET, FETCH, UNION, INTERSECT, EXCEPT, WINDOW) at same depth or closing scope. Match unquoted identifiers ASCII case-insensitively and quoted identifiers exactly; ambiguous resolution => 0. SQL set operations resolve projection from first arm. Unsupported syntax must fail closed if tokenization fails; lexical features are approximate.
canonical.serialization: UTF-8 JSON, ordered schema and rows; nonfinite values normalized null before serialization; SHA256 exact contract file bytes including final LF Hash must be external; no self-referential hash field.

model_io.score_semantics: probabilities in class order; sum to one per row within numerical tolerance; not final-chart confidence
model_io.final_classes: See chart-taxonomy-v1.md; 21 deterministic outputs; kpi_card input alias only
